desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on fresh Iranian air-defense and UAV activity, a reported security incident at U.S. bases in the UK, and a drone strike on a commercial vessel in Romanian waters. The single most important thread is the still-unexplained UK base incident, with details remaining scarce 24 hours later.

## MAIN THREADS
### Iran air activity
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121660137542725927) reports UAV launch from Omidiyeh AB, Khuzestan Province.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121658313750225126) notes uncertain gunfire or air-defense fire near a military barracks.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121651140508991629) and [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121649017809523143) document AA activity on the Marand-Tabriz road and UAVs over Jolfa/Hadishahr in East Azerbaijan.

### UK U.S. bases incident
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2121659197071008191) states details on the RAF Lakenheath event (possible bomb threat or drone incursion) remain extremely scarce, with no official EUCOM or Pentagon update; sirens and lockdowns also affected RAF Mildenhall and RAF Feltwell.

### Black Sea shipping strike
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2121657938574270589) and [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2121648664598983150) report a drone hit the Palau-flagged Larisa-1 (or Larissa 1) in Romanian territorial waters; crane damaged, no injuries or fire, vessel bound for Ukraine.

### Ukraine front-line repulse
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2121657938574270589) shares 93rd Mechanized Brigade footage of a failed Russian assault near Druzhkivka on 11 November, with vehicles and motorcycles destroyed.

### CENTCOM regional posture
- [@CENTCOM](https://x.com/CENTCOM/status/2121652499002040660) posts F-16 patrol imagery over Middle East waters, noting 1.7 billion barrels of oil shipped through Strait of Hormuz under U.S. protection; [@Archer83Able](https://x.com/Archer83Able/status/2121656280557211730) quotes and adds munitions loadout details.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121660137542725927) — UAV launch from Omidiyeh AB (unconfirmed).
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121658313750225126) — gunfire/air-defense near barracks in Iran (unconfirmed).
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2121659197071008191) — specific bases affected and lack of official statements (unconfirmed).
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2121657938574270589) — exact damage to Larisa-1 crane (unconfirmed).
- [@Archer83Able](https://x.com/Archer83Able/status/2121656280557211730) — munitions loadout on F-16s (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for any official EUCOM/Pentagon statement on the UK bases and follow-on Iranian air activity reports. Ukrainian repulses and Black Sea shipping incidents may generate further footage or claims in the coming hours.
